general.title: Complianty
general.description: Connects the shop to Complianty (GDPR compliance).

connection.title: Connection
connection.tokenHelp: Created in Complianty for the client and website. The token is stored encrypted and never shown again.

state.no_token: Not connected. No data is sent to Complianty.
state.unauthorized: The token was rejected. Please create a new token in Complianty.
state.subscription_inactive: Connected, but the Complianty subscription is not active.
state.feature_not_available: Connected, but the plan does not include integrations.
state.forbidden: The token lacks the required permissions.
state.rate_limited: Too many requests. Please try again in a minute.

dse.title: Privacy policy

state.lapsed: The Complianty subscription has lapsed. The notice from the service is shown.
state.not_approved: The privacy policy is not yet approved in Complianty.
state.missing: There is no privacy policy for this website in Complianty yet.

dse.copyYes: A local copy is served by the shop.
dse.copyNo: There is no local copy yet, nothing appears in the shop.
dse.usage: Usage: in the Shopping Experiences editor, drag the "Privacy policy (Complianty)" element onto your privacy page. The sync runs every 6 hours.

scan.notAllowed: This token is not allowed to start scans. You can allow it for the token in Complianty.

scanMessage.running: The scan is running. This page updates when it is finished.
scanMessage.alreadyRunning: A scan is already running. The result appears here when it is finished.
scanMessage.timeout: This takes longer than expected. The result appears later via "Refresh".
scanMessage.pollError: The scan state could not be read. Please reload the page.
scanMessage.cooldown: A scan was started for this website a short while ago. Please try again in {wait}.
scanMessage.budget: The daily scan budget of your plan is used up. Please try again tomorrow.
scanMessage.noScopeRight: This token is not allowed to start scans. You can allow it for the token in Complianty.

scanMessage.unsafeUrl: The address of this website cannot be checked from outside, for example because it is local or private.
